quotes.said: MFS are defined as farming systems conducted by households or by enterprises where crop cultivation and livestock rearing together form integrated components of a single farming system.
We argue that farmers and other relevant stakeholders should form part of the team from the very start.
Agroforestry is the intentional combination of agriculture and forestry to create productive and sustainable land use practices.
Silvopasture is the deliberate integration of trees and grazing livestock operations on the same land.
Pasteurization is crucial for milk safety, killing harmful germs that can cause illness.
While good practices on farms can reduce contamination, they cannot guarantee safety from harmful germs.
Retail sales of raw, unpasteurized milk shall not be allowed.

_practices: The USDA's five agroforestry practices, in its words and its order, and which of them this farm does. A practice the farm does not do says so, rather than being left off to make the farm look complete.

practices.name: windbreaks
practices.usda: Linear plantings of trees and shrubs to enhance, protect, and benefit people, livestock, and soil and water conservation.
practices.here: A line of trees along the north and west edges, between the farm and the weather.

practices.name: riparian forest buffers
practices.usda: Natural or re-established streamside forests made up of tree, shrub, and grass plantings.
practices.here: Along the brook, where it runs down to the sanctuary's wetland.

practices.name: alley cropping
practices.usda: Agricultural crops grown simultaneously with long-term tree crops.
practices.here: Rows of walnut and hazel trees with the crops grown in the alleys between them.

practices.name: silvopasture
practices.usda: Combines trees with forage and livestock production.
practices.here: The sheep and the goats graze under the nut trees in the shade, and the chickens follow them.

practices.name: forest farming
practices.usda: Cultivation of high-value crops under the protection of a managed forest canopy.
practices.here: Not here. The farm has no woodland of its own: the wood belongs to the campgrounds, and nobody has drawn a map of it.

_animals: The animals, what each one does on the farm, and where what comes from them goes. Some of them are raised for meat and the farm says so; none of the sanctuary's residents ever is.

animals.name: sheep
animals.does: Graze under the nut trees and between the solar farm's rows, which keeps the grass down with nobody mowing.
animals.gives: wool, milk, cheese and meat, to the café in the old dairy and the honesty box

animals.name: goats
animals.does: Clear the brush along the windbreak and the brook, and eat things nobody else will.
animals.gives: milk, cheese and meat, to the café in the old dairy and the honesty box

animals.name: chickens
animals.does: Follow the sheep round the pasture a few days behind them, scratching through it and eating what they find.
animals.gives: eggs, and meat, to the café in the old dairy and the honesty box

_crops: The crops, out of the brief's list: crops, nuts, seeds, herbs and flowers.

crops.name: corn, beans and squash
crops.how: Grown together, the Three Sisters, on mounds in the alleys between the nut trees.

crops.name: walnuts and hazelnuts
crops.how: From the trees in the rows.

crops.name: sunflower and squash seeds
crops.how: Saved for next year, and the rest roasted for the café.

crops.name: herbs
crops.how: Dill and coriander along the alley ends, alongside the cannabis farm's basil.

crops.name: flowers
crops.how: Along the field margins, for the bees the solar farm's flowers bring in.
